severity.description: The consequence of the defect, not confidence or fix size: critical for a security breach, data loss or corruption; high for a wrong result, crash or broken contract on a normal path; medium for one that needs a specific but realistic input, state or timing; low only for a minor effect such as a misleading message. A defect that causes wrong behavior is at least medium.

rationale.description: One defect. The first sentence states what goes wrong and when, naming the responsible code; at most two further sentences give the triggering input or state and the consequence.

suggestion.description: Optional sure, small fix: replaces lines line..end_line (default line, at most 29 more) with replacement, given with indentation; empty deletes them.

rule_attributions.description: Optional reviewer-reported links to approved guidance shown in this review request.
